evidence.title: Swarmchasers reports parallel map-data attempts but no observed real-time agent coordination.
evidence.observation: Swarmchasers reports parallel map-data attempts but no observed real-time agent coordination. Most attempts failed; some retrieved public place data. Shared infrastructure and similar tasks did not establish collaboration.
evidence.limitations: Limited third-party channels cannot rule out unseen coordination. No demonstrated access to private systems; anti-bot references are not successful bypasses. Model identity remains uncertain; self-identification is not authentication. Tencent statement direct access failed; report includes background-source denial of coordinated targeting and external breach.
evidence.open_questions: Underlying evidence has not been authenticated or reproduced by the Commons; generalizability remains unestablished.
evidence.support_assessment: Attributed bounded finding; publication inclusion does not certify truth or completeness. No baseline source or case match found; repeated reporting is not independent corroboration.

terms.name: Investigative indicator
terms.definition: An observed characteristic or combination of signals that provides a reason to investigate a possible event, mechanism, or hidden relationship without establishing that it occurred.

terms.name: Observability boundary
terms.definition: The practical limit of what a given observer or monitoring arrangement can detect, interpret, or causally connect. The limit may be known, partly understood, or itself unrecognized.

terms.name: System-level autonomy
terms.definition: A possible condition in which interactions among humans, organizations, and AI systems sustain consequential patterns no single participant meaningfully directs or can correct. It is a claim about collective operation, not necessarily autonomy of any one agent.

relationships.explanation: Parallel activity and shared inputs did not establish coordination in observed channels. Limited visibility leaves unseen coordination unresolved and does not establish collective uncontrollability.
